meta: API Development and Integration Services | Argix
API development and integration services: REST and GraphQL APIs, payment, CRM and ERP integrations on .NET, Python and Laravel, with API security testing.
h1: APIs and integrations that connect your systems securely
lead: Well-documented APIs and reliable connections between your software, your partners and the services you depend on.

items.p: Clean, versioned APIs for your apps, partners and customers.
Checkout, subscriptions, refunds and payouts through your payment provider.
Customer, order and finance data kept in sync across systems.
Connections to EHRs, labs and pharmacies through HL7 and FHIR.
Secure links to banks, processors and financial data providers.
Integrations with the services your business depends on.

items: Limits on how often an API can be called
Versioning so updates do not break partners
Retry and error handling for third-party services

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Can you connect systems that do not have an API?
Often, yes. Depending on the system we use its export files, its database or a small connector service, and we explain the trade-offs first.
Do you document the APIs you build?
Yes. Every API comes with documentation your developers and partners can use.

items.p: Portals, dashboards and business systems on .NET and Angular.
Payments, lending, onboarding and digital banking software with strong security.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
